title: Long-rest spell preparation tool/lifecycle (prepared casters)
description: Level-up (eshyra-ug4i.2.1) offers only an OPTIONAL 'prepare' descriptor. SRD: cleric/druid/paladin/wizard change their prepared list when they finish a long rest. Add a model tool/lifecycle step that sets sheet.spellcasting.prepared (and the sheet.spells union) after a long rest, reusing levelUpSpells evaluateSpellFilter + the class preparation formula (packages/core/src/character/levelUpSpells.ts). Also owns domain/oath always-prepared spells.
acceptance_criteria:
- A long-rest preparation tool/lifecycle step operates from the stored character sheet (sheet.spellcasting.prepared and the derived sheet.spells union) for prepared casters only (cleric, druid, paladin, wizard).
- The prepared count uses each class's own SRD formula (cleric/druid/wizard: spellcasting modifier + class level; paladin: Charisma modifier + half paladin level rounded down; minimum 1); wizard preparation draws only from the spellbook, cleric/druid/paladin from the class list at levels they have slots for.
- Domain/oath (and, once eshyra-91o0 records the land, circle) always-prepared spells are included and do not count against the limit.
- Changing the prepared list is bound to finishing a long rest, per the SRD.
- No rewrite of the general rest engine or of other rest-reset behavior.
